Acme Corporation Employee Handbook (Excerpt)

Remote Work Policy
Employees may work remotely up to three days per week, subject to manager approval.
Remote work requests must be submitted through the human resources portal at least
five business days in advance. Employees working remotely must remain reachable
during core hours, which are 10:00 to 16:00 in their local time zone. The company
provides a home office stipend of 500 dollars per year for eligible remote workers.

Expense Reimbursement
Employees may claim reimbursement for approved business expenses within thirty days
of purchase. Itemized receipts are required for every expense above twenty-five
dollars. Reimbursements are processed on the next regular payroll cycle.

Information Security
Company laptops must use full-disk encryption and must connect through the corporate
virtual private network when accessing internal systems from outside the office.
Passwords must be at least fourteen characters long and must not be reused across
company systems.
